verify_email.subject: Verify your goexchange email
verify_email.title: Welcome to goexchange
verify_email.intro: Thanks for signing up. To finish creating your account and start trading, please confirm this email address.
verify_email.fallback: If the button above does not work, paste this link into your browser:
verify_email.ignore: If you did not create an account, you can safely ignore this email.

reset_password.subject: Reset your goexchange password
reset_password.title: Reset your password
reset_password.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your account. If you made this request, click the button below to set a new password.
reset_password.fallback: If the button above does not work, paste this link into your browser:
reset_password.ignore: If you did not request a reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your password will not be changed.
